subject: SigmaRetail: Consolidated pen-test artifacts + remediation tracker
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: James Hooper <james.hooper@sigmaretail.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sec-team@sigmaretail.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: full pen-test artifacts + remediation status

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, SigmaRetail needs a single archive containing: the latest penetration test PDF, ephemeral evidence files (screenshots, pcap snippets), the current remediation tracker, and a short executive summary that maps high/med/low findings to owners and ETA for fixes. Our procurement/security team is on a tight cadence and would like these by EOD Friday (2027-04-02) so we can proceed with our compliance signoff.

Can you also include any scoped exclusions (e.g., test accounts, internal-only nets) so our assessor can reconcile? If there are outstanding remediation items that will extend past your ETA, please flag them in the tracker.

Attaching our intake form for reference (we will circulate it internally after we receive your package).

Thanks,
James Hooper
Security Program Manager
SigmaRetail

--- Message 2 ---
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: James Hooper <james.hooper@sigmaretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-01T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test artifacts + remediation status

Hi James —

We can assemble the package and deliver an initial bundle by EOD Friday. Plan:
- Monica will pull the pen-test PDF and raw artifact bundle from the security share.
- Rishi will export the asset inventory and confirm any scoped network segments.
- I will compile an executive one-pager mapping severity -> owner -> ETA and produce the remediation-tracker spreadsheet you requested.

Two quick asks so we pack exactly what you need:
1) Confirm whether you need raw pcap files or just PNG excerpts and command logs (pcap may contain customer data; we can provide redacted excerpts).
2) If your assessor requires CRA/acknowledgement that we used third-party tester X (contractual disclosure), let us know.

We will CC our CS contact if you want a walkthrough of the tracker once it's uploaded.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-02T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test artifacts + remediation status

Folks — quick status update and blockers: I pulled the pen-test report (Sigma_Redwood_Pentest_20270328.pdf) and the raw artifact bundle, but the raw bundle includes two items that need provenance notes before we hand them out: a set of db-query-logs (may contain PII) and a full pcap for the internal test harness. Security policy recommends redaction for PII in logs and providing a pcap excerpt (timestamps + relevant flows) instead of the full capture.

I've started the remediation tracker (columns: finding id, severity, description, owner, ETA, status, mitigation notes, evidence link). Current outstanding items I flagged:
- FIND-117: auth bypass (owner: Rishi) — ETA 2027-04-09
- FIND-123: stale cert on metrics cluster (owner: Karthik) — ETA 2027-04-05 (in progress)
- FIND-130: S3 ACL misconfig (owner: infra) — ETA TBD (need infra owner)

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm whether DB query logs can be redacted or must be omitted.
- Karthik: confirm cert replacement schedule and provide PR link.
- Lauren: please confirm whether Sigma wants the full pcap (unlikely) or excerpt.

I'll attach the draft tracker and the pen-test pdf to the delivery bundle.

Attachments referenced: pen-test pdf, draft remediation-tracker (spreadsheet stub).

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test artifacts + remediation status

Quick update / final payload ready:

I redacted the DB query logs (removed user identifiers and any customer-unique tokens) and exported a pcap excerpt limited to 6 flows that illustrate FIND-117 and FIND-123. Attached is the remediation-tracker-20270403.xlsx with owner rows filled and ETA column populated where known. Karthik: I included the PR link for cert rotation (GIT: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/PR-8842) in the tracker notes. Monica: I left S3 ACL as "Infra - owner needed" and added a Jira stub SEC-4421.

Summary for Sigma:
- Package contents: Sigma_PenTest_Report_v2.pdf, redacted-db-queries.csv, pcap-excerpt-FIND117.pcap, remediation-tracker-20270403.xlsx, network-asset-inventory.csv.
- Scoped exclusions: internal-only test harness (10.10.0.0/24), synthetic test accounts (acct-test-*), monitoring endpoints used by test harness.
- Outstanding items: S3 ACL owner assignment (we will assign by 2027-04-06) and one low-severity info-leak that is a documentation edit (ETA 2027-04-07).

James/Team — bundle is uploaded to our shared Drive and I can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow morning if you want us to step through the tracker.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
